name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover storm-related drywall replacement?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover storm-related drywall replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage from storms, which often includes drywall replacement. However, coverage specifics depend on your policy, the cause of the water intrusion (e.g., roof leak vs. flood), and your deductible. It's essential to review your policy documents or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage limits and the claims process for storm damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance typically covers storm-related drywall damage if it's sudden and accidental. Review your policy or contact your provider for specific coverage details.
